mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM PROCUREMENT_DEMAND WHERE ID=#{projectId} AND DELETED=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_REVIEW_WORKFLOW (ID, PROJECT_ID, CURRENT_STEP_ORDER, STATUS, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{currentStepOrder}, #{status}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime})

INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_REVIEW_STEP (WORKFLOW_ID, STEP_CODE, STEP_ORDER, STEP_NAME, STATUS, COMPLETED_TIME, RESULT_SUMMARY) VALUES (#{step.workflowId}, #{step.stepCode}, #{step.stepOrder}, #{step.stepName}, #{step.status}, #{step.completedTime}, #{step.resultSummary})
mapper.update: UPDATE PROCUREMENT_REVIEW_WORKFLOW SET CURRENT_STEP_ORDER=#{currentStepOrder}, STATUS=#{status}, UPDATED_TIME=#{updatedTime} WHERE ID=#{id}
UPDATE PROCUREMENT_REVIEW_STEP SET STATUS=#{status}, COMPLETED_TIME=#{completedTime}, RESULT_SUMMARY=#{resultSummary} WHERE WORKFLOW_ID=#{workflowId} AND STEP_CODE=#{stepCode}
mapper.select: SELECT ID, PROJECT_ID, CURRENT_STEP_ORDER, STATUS, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME FROM PROCUREMENT_REVIEW_WORKFLOW WHERE PROJECT_ID=#{projectId}
SELECT WORKFLOW_ID, STEP_CODE, STEP_ORDER, STEP_NAME, STATUS, COMPLETED_TIME, RESULT_SUMMARY FROM PROCUREMENT_REVIEW_STEP WHERE WORKFLOW_ID=#{workflowId} ORDER BY STEP_ORDER
